name: fs-operation-scope-enforced
body: Law (prose; assessed by review): a filesystem operation (`apg_rm` / `apg_mv` / `apg_cp`) may touch ONLY a path matched by the acting agent's granted globs — the source path, and for mv/cp the destination path as well. The TOOL enforces this: it resolves the path against the caller's project directory, reads the acting agent's granted globs from the caller's agent permission block (via the opencode plugin context), and refuses a path outside that scope; enforcement does not live in the permission layer's matching of the tool's path argument. No operation may cross the caller's project/worktree boundary. The capability is never granted as a blanket `"*": allow`: the grant is deny-by-default with the role's owned globs allowed and every grant mirrored under `apg/.worktrees/*/`. The tools perform plain filesystem operations only — they are not `git rm`/`git mv` — and they never mutate graph nodes (that is `apg node rm` / `apg edge rm`).
